notes.title: Update 4. 15 03 2017
notes.notes:
New icons indicate when you can eat enemies and when you can jump
New title menu
Switch to the gamepad runs smoothly, by enabling the mode in the settings menu 
Improved menu navigation with a controller
The game is rebuilt for the new version of Unity. Some things began to be processed faster!
